observations.body: Peter leads a return to fishing, jumps into the sea when Jesus is recognized, and draws the full net ashore before breakfast.
observations.label: It is the Lord

observations.body: The passage presents Fishing, recognition, swimming, hauling, and eating as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Fishing, recognition, swimming, hauling, and eating

observations.body: The passage places Peter beside Fishing, recognition, swimming, hauling, and eating.
observations.label: Peter

payload.posture: Read John 21:1–14 as one movement in Peter's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states peter leads a return to fishing, jumps into the sea when Jesus is recognized, and draws the full net ashore before breakfast. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Peter's story.
payload.title: It is the Lord
